name: Vinyl wrap
h1: Vinyl car wraps in Columbus, Ohio
title: Vinyl car wraps in Columbus, Ohio | EveryWrap
desc: Full colour-change vinyl wraps in satin, gloss, matte and colour-shift. See real EveryWrap jobs and get a written quote for your car in Columbus, Ohio.
card: A new colour without a respray. Satin black is the one people ask for most.
lead: A wrap changes the colour of your car without repainting it. We cover it panel by panel in vinyl film and tuck the edges, so the old colour does not show at the doors and seams.
points: Finishes
Satin, gloss, matte, colour-shift and printed designs. Satin black is the most requested.
Coverage
Full colour change, or parts: roof, hood, stripes, chrome delete.
Film
Films named in our posted jobs: 3M (44 jobs), Avery Dennison (38) and KPMF (11).
Your paint
The film sits on the factory paint. We look at the paint first, because film will not hide damage and can lift a poor respray.
faq: Will a wrap damage my paint?
On sound factory paint, quality film comes off cleanly. Repainted or chipped panels are the risk, so we inspect the car before we quote and tell you what we see.
Can you wrap just part of the car?
Yes. Roofs, hoods, stripes and chrome delete are all common jobs in our archive.
How is a wrap priced?
By the size of the vehicle, the film you choose and how much of the car is covered. You get the price in writing before any work starts.
How do I look after it?
Hand wash, no abrasive polish, and keep fuel and bird droppings from sitting on the film. We give you care instructions with the job.

name: Paint protection film
h1: Paint protection film (PPF) in Columbus, Ohio
title: Paint protection film (PPF) in Columbus, Ohio | EveryWrap
desc: Clear paint protection film for the panels that take stone chips: bumper, hood, fenders and mirrors, or the whole car. Written quotes in Columbus, Ohio.
card: Clear film on the panels that take the stone chips.
lead: Paint protection film is a clear layer over the paint. It takes the stone chips, bug marks and light scratches so the paint underneath does not.
points: Partial front
The bumper and the leading edge of the hood and fenders.
Full front
The bumper, the whole hood, both fenders and the mirrors.
Full body
Every painted panel.
With a wrap or tint
Protection film, a colour wrap and tint can be planned as one job, so the car is only off the road once.
faq: Can you see the film?
On clean paint it is hard to spot. Edges are placed along panel lines where they are least visible.
Which coverage should I choose?
Full front covers the area that takes most of the damage on the road. Full body is for a car you plan to keep a long time. Tell us how you use the car and we will say what we would do.
How is it priced?
By the panels covered and the size of the vehicle. You get the price in writing first.

name: Window tint
title: Window tint in Columbus, Ohio | EveryWrap
desc: Window tint in 70, 35, 20 and 5 percent shades, fitted to your car in Columbus, Ohio. See each shade on a car and get a written quote.
card: Four shades. See each one on the glass before you choose.
lead: Tint cuts glare and heat and gives the car a finished look. The number is how much light gets through: 70% is light, 5% is limo dark.
points: Light. Barely changes the look, takes the edge off the sun.
Medium. A clear step darker than factory glass.
Dark. The common choice for rear glass.
Limo. Very dark, for rear windows.
faq: What is legal in Ohio?
Front side windows must let in at least 50% of light. Rear side windows and the back glass can go darker. We confirm what applies to your car before we cut film.
Can I roll the windows down afterwards?
Not straight away. The film needs time to cure, and we tell you how long when you collect the car.
How is tint priced?
By the number of windows and the film. You get the price in writing first.

points: Find

Fit
Test fit first, then install.
Finish
Wrapped with the rest of the car, or in a contrast finish such as gloss black or carbon.
faq: Do you supply the kit?
We can source it, or fit one you already have. Send the year, make and model and we will tell you what is available.
Can it be removed later?
That depends on the kit. Bolt-on parts come off; parts that are bonded or need cutting are permanent. We tell you which before you commit.
How is it priced?
The kit, the fitting and the wrap are quoted separately so you can see each one. All in writing first.
